summary: GridAI Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a Debt Settlement and Subscription Agreement with lender 1396974 BC Ltd. The company will satisfy a defaulted $1,014,675 obligation by paying $800,000 in cash ($700,000 principal + $100,000 interest) and issuing 71,482 shares of common stock at a deemed price of $3.25 per share for remaining accrued interest of $232,315. The agreement resolves a prior default under a Revolving Loan Agreement whose maturity date passed on January 31, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned. The structure is a debt-for-equity swap with partial cash settlement. Watch for shareholder dilution and any additional financing needs.
